events.description: Kimberly was born biologically female and grew up in a small farming community
events.quote: I was born as a biological female in 1973

events.description: At age 19, surgery removed an ovarian cyst and a biopsy revealed an ovotesticular disorder of sex development
events.quote: At age 19, I had surgery to remove a grapefruit-sized cyst

events.description: He changed his name to Aaron at age 22
events.quote: I changed my name to Aaron when I was 22.

events.description: In the early 2000s he moved to Vancouver and met trans people
events.quote: In the early 2000s, I moved to Vancouver

events.description: Around 2007, after a documentary on trans kids, he decided to transition
events.quote: around 2007, I saw a documentary on TV about trans kids

events.description: He had bottom surgery with complications and now regrets it
events.quote: I do regret getting bottom surgery done

events.description: He testified in an Ontario human rights case against a school board (N.B. v. Ottawa-Carleton DSB)
events.quote: I also provided testimony in an Ontario human rights case against an Ontario school board

events.description: He was a panelist on aetiologies of GD at a clinical conference in Finland
events.quote: I was a panelist on the topic of aetiologies of GD.

events.description: Saskatchewan implemented its 2023 'Use of Preferred First Name and Pronouns by Students' policy, which UR Pride challenged
Kimberly swore the affidavit in Saskatoon
